name: design_v2
prompt: Dark 3D game, vertical camera rising up inside a tall cylindrical tunnel whose walls are lined with thousands of small glowing black-and-white archive film frames in rings, like a tomography scan of old films. A translucent jellyfish whose bell is made of glowing particles showing a moving sepia film image, and whose long tentacles are curling strips of 35mm film stock with sprocket holes, swims upward with slow pulses; when a tentacle brushes the wall, the frames there light up and start to play. Soft upward currents of light, a few drifting red ink clouds. Chase camera below and behind the jellyfish, smooth.
